title: Add X-Usenet-IPFS-CID header to ARTICLE and HEAD responses
description:
Why: every article stored in usenet-ipfs has a stable CIDv1 (DAG-CBOR, SHA2-256). Exposing it as an article header lets CID-aware tools (archival scripts, Corundum indexer, IPFS pinning automation) discover the CID from a normal NNTP fetch without any custom command. Standard newsreaders ignore unrecognised headers per RFC 5322 §3.6.8.

What: inject X-Usenet-IPFS-CID: <cidv1-string> into the header block of every ARTICLE and HEAD response. The value is the DAG-CBOR CIDv1 of the article root block as stored in IPFS. It is also present in the article's own stored header (written at POST/ingest time), so for ARTICLE it is a passthrough; for HEAD it must be synthesized from the msgid→CID map if not already in the stored headers.
design: Inject at the reader session layer when serializing article headers, not at storage layer. Look up CID from MsgIdMap by message-id. If not found, omit header silently. Header name: X-Usenet-IPFS-CID (singular, matches the primary content CID). Value: multibase base32upper CIDv1 string (bafyrei... form).
